verbose_level.description: Verbosity level. 0 for quiet, 1 for verbose. Corresponds to the number of -v flags used.

no_pnp.description: If true, do not search for Plug 'n Play mice. Corresponds to the -n flag.

xf86_v3.description: If true, produce output appropriate for XFree86 3.x configuration. Corresponds to the -o flag.

xf86_v4.description: If true, produce output appropriate for XFree86 4.x configuration. Corresponds to the -x flag.
